reasoning_details.text:
Tennessee is the critical piece in the orange monopoly—with St. James at Grok and New York at Gemini, whoever controls Tennessee blocks anyone from completing the set without negotiating. If I win it, the property becomes deadlocked; if Grok takes it, they'd have two of three and could pressure Gemini into a trade.

I have enough cash to bid up to around $280-300 while still funding light-blue development, and holding Tennessee gives me serious leverage as a trade broker since both rivals need it. I'm bidding $200 to maintain pressure and see if Grok pushes further.
